futureQuestionIntake.rule: Future visitor questions require a private consented intake, privacy and moderation rules, deletion and correction handling, duplicate triage and human editorial selection. No visitor question may publish or receive an automatic public answer.

records.question: Dear Miss Jeeves, why does AI keep agreeing to my instructions and then ignoring them?
Dear Miss Jeeves, why does AI make up sources that look completely real?
Dear Miss Jeeves, why does AI forget something I told it earlier?
Dear Miss Jeeves, why does the output sometimes get worse after fifteen revisions?
records.userSituation: A reader has corrected the same long-running AI job many times; the system agrees with each correction while later versions lose earlier requirements or become less useful.
records.directAnswer: Later revisions often optimize for the latest complaint while no external authority or rerunnable check protects the whole original job; acknowledgement is generated text, not enforced compliance.
records.mechanism: Repeated or competing context can amplify in a long session, serial local corrections can displace earlier requirements, and a prompt or rule file remains advisory unless the workflow loads it and validates the resulting artifact.
records.commonMisunderstanding: More instructions must create more control, and starting a new session is the universal recovery.
records.readerMove: Keep one reconciled whole-job brief and the last good artifact outside the chat; replace superseded instructions instead of appending conflicts, define stable work and life test cases, change one thing, rerun every check and promote only a passing candidate; preserve checkpoints for any context refresh or handoff.
records.productBoundary: Context handling, attachments, tools, permissions, outages and model changes differ by product. Persistent failure against a stable test can require a workflow, tool, model or human-control change rather than another prompt revision.
